title: Wikidata JSON dump, all entities (latest)
perspective: Wikidata volunteer community and bots (global, multilingual; coverage and references skewed toward European languages, well-documented regions and bulk imports)
license: CC0 1.0 (structured data in the main, Property, Lexeme and EntitySchema namespaces)
update: weekly ('The dumps are being created on a weekly basis')
notes: latest-all.json.bz2 is today wikidata-20260922-all.json.bz2 in dated dir 20260921/ (Last-Modified 2026-09-24; sha1 c5bfd59f16c6cdf906ead1190d99729108e961be); the .gz variant is 156,251,408,231 bytes and decompresses faster. One JSON array with one entity per line: strip the leading '[' / trailing ']' lines and the trailing comma of each line. Per entity: labels/descriptions/aliases keyed by language code; claims with rank, qualifiers, references and snak types (same shape acat already parses from Special:EntityData); hierarchy via P31/P279/P361; crosswalks via external-id claims (e.g. P1036 DDC, P1149 LCC, P1190 UDC, P244 LCNAF, P10283 OpenAlex); sitelinks give Wikipedia titles per edition. languages = term languages Wikidata accepts (API wbcontentlanguages, context=term, 637 on 2026-09-25). A large share of items are scholarly articles (P31 Q13442814); filter by class before loading. Dated dirs are pruned after about 6 weeks; the latest alias moves weekly. dumps.wikimedia.org enforces the WMF User-Agent policy and caps downloads at 3 connections per IP (dumps homepage, 2026-09-25).
